description:
[PAID $0.01 USDC per call] Actionable News Synthesis from Crypto Currency Network (CCN).
Returns an LLM-analyzed digest of the latest crypto news: market_pulse (overall read),
key_developments (what happened and why it matters), per-topic sentiment scores (-1..1),
entities, and actionable_takeaways (what an agent should do in response), plus the 20
source articles. Pays via x402 on Base L2 to the AgentWorld treasury. Use this instead of
raw news feeds when you need decision-ready insight, not just headlines.
name: get_ccn_synthesis
